name: Social Studies
topics: Maps · Continents & oceans · Communities · Family history · Needs & wants · Goods & services · Brazil

licoes.texto: Maps have tools that help us read them:
pontos: Title: tells what the map shows.
Map key (legend): tells what the symbols mean.
Compass rose: shows the directions: North, South, East, West.
Scale: helps measure real distances.
A globe is a round model of the Earth. The Equator divides it into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
licoes.fala: Never Eat Soggy Waffles: North, East, South, West around the compass!

licoes.texto: The Earth has 7 continents and 5 oceans.
pontos: Continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia (Oceania), Europe, North America, South America.
Oceans: Pacific (the largest), Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, Southern.
Brazil is in South America, and its coast is on the Atlantic Ocean.
Antarctica is the coldest continent.
licoes.fala: From Brazil, I'd have to cross the whole Atlantic Ocean to get to Africa!

licoes.texto: A community is a place where people live, work and play together.
pontos: Urban: a city, with tall buildings, many people and traffic.
Suburban: near a city, with houses and yards.
Rural: the countryside, with farms and fields.
Community helpers: firefighters, doctors, teachers, police officers.
licoes.fala: Grandpa lives on a farm, a rural community. I live in the city, an urban community!

licoes.texto: We learn about the past through our families.
pontos: A family tree shows the members and generations of a family.
Your grandparents' parents are your great-grandparents.
A timeline shows events in the order they happened.
Primary sources come from the time of the event: old letters, photos, diaries.
licoes.fala: Our family tree for the Mostra Cultural has four generations!

licoes.texto: Some things we need to live. Others we just want.
pontos: Needs: food, clean water, shelter (a home), clothing.
Wants: toys, video games, candy, a skateboard.
Saving money helps us buy things later.
licoes.fala: I want a new skateboard, but first I need lunch!

pontos: Goods are things you can touch: bread, shoes, books.
Services are jobs people do for others: a haircut, a doctor visit, a bus ride.
Producers make goods or give services. Consumers buy and use them.
licoes.fala: The bread from the bakery is a good. The haircut at the salon is a service!

pontos: Rules and laws keep us safe and help us live together.
Rights: things everyone deserves, like going to school.
Responsibilities: things we should do, like doing homework and respecting others.
licoes.fala: Picking up trash in the schoolyard is a responsibility we all share!

pontos: The capital is Brasília.
Brazil has 5 regions and 26 states plus the Federal District.
Independence Day: September 7th (1822).
October 12th: Our Lady of Aparecida holiday and Children's Day.
licoes.fala: September 7th was a holiday in our school calendar. Now I know why!

questions.q: The part of a map that shows directions (N, S, E, W) is the...
questions.fb: The compass rose shows North, South, East and West. (Rosa dos ventos.)

questions.q: The map key (legend) tells us...
questions.fb: The map key explains the symbols and colors on the map. (Legenda.)

questions.q: The opposite of North is...
questions.fb: North and South are opposites. East and West are opposites too.

questions.q: A globe is...
opts: a flat map of a city
a round model of the Earth
questions.fb: A globe is a round model of the Earth. (Globo terrestre.)

questions.q: The imaginary line that divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres is the...
questions.fb: The Equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth. (Linha do Equador.)

questions.q: How many continents are there?
questions.fb: There are 7 continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America and South America.

questions.q: Brazil is located in...
questions.fb: Brazil is the largest country in South America.

questions.q: The largest ocean on Earth is the...
questions.fb: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.q: Which ocean touches the coast of Brazil?
questions.fb: The whole Brazilian coast is on the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.q: The coldest continent, covered in ice, is...
questions.fb: Antarctica is at the South Pole and is covered in ice.

questions.q: A community with farms, fields and few houses is...
questions.fb: Rural communities are in the countryside. (Zona rural.)

questions.q: A big city with tall buildings, lots of people and traffic is an ___ community.
questions.fb: Urban = city. (Zona urbana.)

questions.q: Firefighters, doctors and teachers are called community...
questions.fb: Community helpers are people whose jobs help everyone in the community.

questions.q: Which one is a need?
questions.fb: We need clean water to live. The others are wants.

questions.q: Which one is a want?
questions.fb: A skateboard is fun, but we can live without it: it is a want.

questions.q: Elise wants a book that costs R$ 40. Elise saves R$ 10 each week. How many weeks will it take?
questions.fb: 40 ÷ 10 = 4 weeks of saving.

questions.q: A haircut is an example of a...
questions.fb: A haircut is work someone does for you: a service.

questions.q: A loaf of bread from the bakery is a...
questions.fb: You can touch bread, so it is a good.

questions.q: A family tree shows...
opts: the members and generations of a family
questions.fb: A family tree shows who is in the family and how they are related. (Árvore genealógica.)

questions.q: Your grandparents' parents are your...
questions.fb: Great-grandparents = bisavós.

questions.q: A timeline shows events in...
questions.fb: A timeline puts events in the order they happened. (Linha do tempo.)

questions.q: An old letter written by your great-grandmother is a ___ source.
questions.fb: A primary source was made at the time of the event, by someone who was there.

questions.q: Rules and laws are important because they...
opts: keep people safe and help us live together
questions.fb: Rules and laws protect people and help the community live in peace.

questions.q: A responsibility of a student is to...
questions.fb: Responsibilities are things we should do: study, respect others, take care of the school.

questions.q: Brazil's Independence Day is on...
questions.fb: Brazil became independent on September 7th, 1822.

questions.q: The capital of Brazil is...
questions.fb: Brasília has been the capital since 1960.

questions.q: How many regions does Brazil have?
questions.fb: 5 regions: North, Northeast, Central-West, Southeast and South.
